pages.title: Batman and Robin Teaming Up with Superman to Protect Metropolis Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin team up with Superman to protect Metropolis in this printable coloring page, standing together beneath the city's distinctive globe-topped building. Superman takes the central pose with his hands on his hips, while the three chest emblems, utility belts, and long capes create clear sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Planning a Mission with Batgirl and Nightwing Around a Batcave Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin planning a Batcave mission with Batgirl and Nightwing, gathered around a round table covered with maps. Their gloved hands point toward the plans, with computer screens and rocky cave walls behind them. The coloring sheet combines broad costume panels with smaller map outlines and control buttons.

pages.title: Batman and Carrie Kelley as Robin Facing the Mutant Gang in the Dark Knight Returns Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Carrie Kelley as Robin face the Mutant gang in this printable coloring page inspired by The Dark Knight Returns, surrounded by rubble. Carrie's large glasses and short cape contrast with Batman's bulky silhouette, while the gang wears spiked collars and tall mohawks. A fence and distant city buildings frame the confrontation on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Lego Batman and Robin Beside the Scuttler Outside Gotham City Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: Lego Batman and Robin stand beside the Scuttler outside Gotham City Hall in this printable coloring page, with the Bat-signal shining above the roof. The machine's jointed legs and bat-shaped body fill much of the scene, while the heroes occupy the foreground. Steps, columns, brick studs, and a clock tower add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Lego Batman and Robin Chasing Deathstroke's Speedboat in the Batboat Coloring Page
pages.description: Lego Batman and Robin chase Deathstroke's speedboat in the Batboat in this printable coloring page, cutting through curling waves as Robin points ahead toward him. Batman grips the steering wheel, and Deathstroke's crossed swords rise behind his masked head. Studded boat panels, bat emblems, and angular splashes give the coloring sheet a distinctly brick-built appearance.

pages.title: Lego Batman and Robin Joining Batgirl to Stop the Joker at Arkham Asylum Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lego Batman and Robin joining Batgirl against the Joker at Arkham Asylum, with a tall barred gate behind them. Robin carries a staff, Batgirl leaps forward, and the grinning Joker holds an oversized weapon. Pointed towers and small winged statues surround the action without hiding the four minifigures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Lego Batman and Robin Inspecting the Batcave's Rotating Batsuit Wardrobe Coloring Page
pages.description: Lego Batman and Robin inspect the Batcave's rotating Batsuit wardrobe in this printable coloring page, studying two displayed costumes beneath a large geared mechanism. Batman rests a hand near his chin while Robin gestures toward the suits. Brick studs, hanging equipment, and a small computer desk provide compact details around the larger figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin Sparring with Practice Staffs in the Batcave Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin spar with practice staffs in this printable coloring page, facing each other on the rocky floor of the Batcave. Their long poles cross between their ready stances, and a bank of blank monitors sits behind them. Large cape panels contrast with the finer belt pouches and cave contours across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin Exploring Dinosaur Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin explore Dinosaur Island in this printable coloring page, surrounded by tropical plants, a long-necked dinosaur, and a flying reptile. Batman points toward the vegetation while Robin holds a handheld radio beside him. Palm fronds, laced boots, and layered cape edges bring smaller sections into the otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dick Grayson as Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin Landing on a Cathedral Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Dick Grayson as Batman and Damian Wayne as Robin land on a cathedral rooftop in this printable coloring page, crouching beside a stone gargoyle. Their capes sweep outward above the parapet, with a pointed tower rising behind them. The coloring sheet balances large costume shapes against rows of masonry, roof tiles, and a narrow arched window.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Skating Through the Frozen Museum in Batman and Robin 1997 Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin skate through a frozen museum in this printable coloring page inspired by Batman and Robin 1997, passing ice-covered exhibits beneath tall arches. Both heroes wear skates, and their capes trail behind their bent-knee poses. Hanging icicles, display plinths, and cracks in the ice add varied enclosed shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Wearing Ice Armor Outside Gotham Observatory in Batman and Robin 1997 Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Batman and Robin wearing ice armor outside Gotham Observatory, inspired by Batman and Robin 1997, with a telescope above them. Segmented chest plates, shoulder emblems, and reinforced gloves divide their suits into many sections. The observatory dome, icicles, and snowbanks provide a simpler background around the two large figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Teaming Up with Batgirl Against Poison Ivy in Batman and Robin 1997 Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin team up with Batgirl against Poison Ivy in this printable coloring page inspired by Batman and Robin 1997, surrounded by curling vines. Ivy's leaf-shaped costume and sweeping hair fill the foreground while the three heroes stand together behind her. Fine leaf outlines contrast with the broad capes and costume panels on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Dick Grayson as Robin Searching a Clock Tower in Batman the Animated Series Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Dick Grayson as Robin search a clock tower in this printable coloring page inspired by Batman the Animated Series, with Batman carrying a flashlight. Large exposed gears and hanging ropes surround the pair beneath a clock face marked with Roman numerals. The coloring sheet offers broad cape areas alongside smaller teeth, belt compartments, and brick outlines.

pages.title: Batman and Robin with a Flashlight in a Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Tim Drake as Robin explore an abandoned subway in this printable coloring page inspired by The New Batman Adventures, standing beside overgrown tracks. Robin holds a flashlight, and a damaged train car waits in the arched tunnel behind them. pages.title: Batman and Robin Entering the Batcave Through Wayne Manor's Secret Clock Passage Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin enter the Batcave through Wayne Manor's secret clock passage in this printable coloring page, walking beside a tall grandfather clock and open stairway. The clock's pendulum, decorative crown, and visible hinges distinguish the scene, while books line a nearby shelf. Broad wall panels and cape shapes keep the figures clear within the furnished coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Sliding Down Separate Batpoles in the 1966 Television Series Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin slide down separate Batpoles in this printable coloring page inspired by the 1966 television series, each gripping a pole with both hands. Bent knees and short motion marks show their descent, while their capes hang in long open shapes. The sparse background keeps the coloring sheet focused on the two heroes and their classic costume details.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Climbing a Building Wall with the Bat-rope in Batman 1966 Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin climbing a building wall with the Bat-rope in a Batman 1966 scene, their boots braced against the bricks. Two long rope lines lead upward beside a rectangular window. The coloring sheet pairs large cape sections and rounded costume shapes with smaller glove folds, utility-belt compartments, and scattered masonry outlines.

pages.title: Batman Riding the Batcycle with Robin in the Sidecar in Batman 1966 Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman rides the Batcycle with Robin in the sidecar in this printable coloring page inspired by Batman 1966, traveling along a road beneath rounded clouds. Robin waves from the bat-winged sidecar while Batman holds the handlebars. Wheel spokes, exposed engine parts, and matching bat emblems create detailed sections within the vehicle's broad panels on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Facing the Riddler in His Island Lair in Batman Forever Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin face the Riddler in his island lair in this printable coloring page inspired by Batman Forever, surrounded by cave walls and equipment. The Riddler wears a question-mark suit and holds a matching cane beside a tall chair. Screens, control panels, and repeating punctuation patterns add small areas around the heroes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Racing the Batboat Through Gotham Harbor Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin race the Batboat through Gotham Harbor in this printable coloring page, riding through large splashes with a suspension bridge behind them. The compact figures sit side by side as Batman steers and Robin smiles. A bold bat emblem, pointed fins, and simple skyline contours divide the coloring sheet into clear open sections.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Preparing the Batwing for Takeoff in the Batcave Hangar Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin prepare the Batwing for takeoff in this printable coloring page, checking the aircraft beneath the rocky ceiling of the Batcave hangar together. Robin climbs a wheeled boarding staircase while Batman checks a side panel beside the open cockpit. Swept wings, twin tail fins, and a computer console fill out the mechanical details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Repairing the Batmobile on a Batcave Maintenance Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin repairing the Batmobile on a Batcave maintenance platform, with the raised hood revealing gears and engine pipes. Batman holds a wrench while Robin carries a tray of tools beside a wheeled cart. The car's pointed fins and large body panels contrast with the smaller mechanical parts on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Meeting Alfred Beside the Batcave Dinosaur and Giant Penny Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin meet Alfred beside the Batcave dinosaur and giant penny in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a smiling dinosaur display and stalactites. Alfred gestures with one hand, wearing a bow tie and buttoned jacket. The oversized coin portrait, dinosaur scales, and the heroes' chest emblems provide distinct sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Following Ace the Bat-hound Along a Trail in a Gotham Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin follow Ace the Bat-hound along a Gotham park trail in this printable coloring page, passing leafy trees beneath a crescent moon together. Ace wears a pointed cowl, flowing cape, and bat-shaped collar tag as he leads the pair. A bench, lamppost, and distant skyline add recognizable park details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Wearing Breathing Masks in Scarecrow's Fear-toxin Warehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin wearing breathing masks in Scarecrow's fear-toxin warehouse, with curling vapor rising from barrels and surrounding their shoulders. The large filter grids, mask straps, and chest emblems define the close view. Stacked crates, warning symbols, pipes, and shelves create smaller background shapes behind the two figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Facing Bane in a Cracked Gotham Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin face Bane in a cracked Gotham street in this printable coloring page, holding ready stances opposite his large masked figure and raised fists. Tubes loop around Bane's shoulders and arms, and wide cracks spread across the foreground. Simple building outlines and a bent streetlamp frame the three characters on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Tracking Killer Croc Through the Gotham City Sewers Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin track Killer Croc through the Gotham City sewers in this printable coloring page, following clawed footprints along a narrow ledge beside flowing water. Killer Croc peers around an arched opening behind them with sharp teeth and scaled arms. Curving brickwork, drainage pipes, and water ripples add layered details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Spotting Man-bat Hanging Inside a Bell Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin spot Man-Bat hanging inside a bell tower in this printable coloring page, looking upward as Batman points toward the creature above them. Man-Bat hangs upside down beside a large bell, framed by timber beams and dangling ropes. Wing membranes, cobwebs, and brick outlines supply varied sections throughout the tall coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Confronting Clayface on an Abandoned Movie Set Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin confront Clayface on an abandoned movie set in this printable coloring page, standing between old cameras and studio lights with a staff ready. Clayface reaches forward with enormous hands above his dripping, uneven body. Film reels, a director's chair, trailing cables, and damaged scenery surround the three figures with smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Facing the Penguin and His Trick Umbrellas at Gotham Docks Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin face the Penguin and his trick umbrellas at Gotham docks in this printable coloring page, standing on planks beside mooring posts together. The Penguin wears a top hat and monocle while aiming a closed umbrella, with several more propped beside him. Cranes, cargo crates, and a distant ship complete the harbor setting on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Catching Catwoman During a Museum Jewel Heist Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin catch Catwoman during a museum jewel heist in this printable coloring page, reaching toward her as she runs with a bulging jewel bag. Large faceted gems tumble near her feet, with an open display case behind the chase. Columns, a framed picture, and sweeping capes add different enclosed areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Escaping Poison Ivy's Giant Vines in a Greenhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin escape Poison Ivy's giant vines in a greenhouse in this printable coloring page, running between curling tendrils beneath a curved glass roof. Batman raises an arm against a thick vine as Robin follows behind him. Thorny stems, veined leaves, hanging baskets, and rows of potted plants surround the moving figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Dodging Mr. Freeze's Ice Ray in a Frozen Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin dodge Mr. Freeze's ice ray in this printable coloring page, leaping across a frozen laboratory as a swirling blast passes overhead behind them. Mr. Freeze stands in a domed helmet with his large weapon raised. Icicles, control panels, pipes, and angular ice blocks provide contrasting shapes around the caped heroes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Confronting Two-face Beside an Open Bank Vault Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin confront Two-Face beside an open bank vault in this printable coloring page, with scattered coins and money bags lying near their feet. Two-Face holds up a coin in front of the vault's round doorway, wearing a suit divided into smooth and jagged halves. The heavy door's bolts and wheel supply mechanical details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Stopping Masked Bank Robbers Outside a Gotham Bank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin stopping masked robbers outside a Gotham bank, with raised hands, money bags, and a columned entrance behind them. Batman points while holding a Batarang, and Robin stands ready in the foreground. Striped shirts, knit caps, and the bank's large double doors add varied sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Helping a Family Escape a Flooded Gotham Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin help a family escape a flooded Gotham street in this printable coloring page, wading through water beside a partly submerged car together. Batman carries a small child while Robin gestures toward the route ahead of the two adults. Ripples surround their legs, and simple windows, doorways, and a streetlamp complete the urban coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Pursuing the Joker Through an Abandoned Carnival Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin pursue the Joker through an abandoned carnival in this printable coloring page, running past a Ferris wheel and a torn circus tent. The grinning Joker leads the chase in a long jacket and bow tie. Looping roller-coaster tracks, scattered debris, and trailing cables provide smaller outlines behind the three large figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Blocking Harley Quinn's Mallet in a Toy Warehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin block Harley Quinn's mallet in this printable coloring page, raising their hands against the oversized hammer inside a warehouse stacked with toys. Harley wears her pointed jester cap and diamond-patterned suit while gripping the long handle. Shelves of teddy bears, toy trains, alphabet blocks, and cardboard boxes fill the background of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Solving the Riddler's Question-mark Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin solve the Riddler's question-mark maze in this printable coloring page, considering a giant punctuation-shaped puzzle with winding paths and several dead ends. Batman rests a hand beneath his chin while Robin points upward toward the maze. Smaller floating question marks and broad costume areas surround the bold puzzle outline on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman Teaching Robin to Aim a Batarang at a Training Target Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman teaches Robin to aim a Batarang at a training target in this printable coloring page, standing behind his partner and pointing toward the bullseye. Robin holds the bat-shaped tool beside his shoulder with his other arm extended. Concentric target rings, utility-belt compartments, and a few grass tufts provide smaller shapes within the open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman Watching Robin Practice on the Batcave Trapeze Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman watches Robin practice on the Batcave trapeze in this printable coloring page, standing with folded arms as Robin swings overhead beneath the rocky ceiling. Robin grips the bar with both hands, bends his knees, and trails his cape behind him. The suspended ropes and separated rock ledges frame the two large figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Examining Footprints in a Gotham City Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin examining footprints in a Gotham City alley, crouching beside four clear shoe prints as Batman points downward. A trash can, wall ladder, and open doorway establish the narrow setting, with the Bat-signal visible above distant buildings. The coloring sheet keeps the clues distinct beneath the heroes' broad capes.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Receiving a Case File From Commissioner Gordon Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin receive a case file from Commissioner Gordon in this printable coloring page, gathered close together as Gordon passes a thick folder to Batman. Gordon's glasses, mustache, tie, and raised coat collar distinguish him beside the masked heroes. Framed wall panels and the folder's layered edges add smaller outlines to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Rescuing a Child From a Damaged Gotham Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin rescue a child from a damaged Gotham bridge in this printable coloring page, standing on cracked pavement beside a broken guardrail and cables. Batman carries the child while Robin reaches toward them near the edge. Exposed support beams and distant towers add structural details behind the three figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Watching the Bat-signal Above Gotham City Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin watch the Bat-signal above Gotham City in this printable coloring page, standing behind a rooftop parapet as its beam crosses the open sky. The large bat emblem occupies a circular outline overhead, with clouds and layered towers surrounding it. Their still poses and broad cape sections keep the coloring sheet centered on the two heroes.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Driving the Batmobile Through Gotham City Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin drive the Batmobile through Gotham City in this printable coloring page, with Batman steering and Robin waving from the open passenger seat beside him. The rounded car has a large bat emblem on its hood, circular headlights, and pointed rear fins. Tall buildings and simple window patterns frame the cheerful figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Swinging Between Buildings on Separate Grappling Lines Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin swing between buildings on separate grappling lines in this printable coloring page, gripping their ropes above the rooftops beneath a scattering of stars. Their bent legs and lifted capes emphasize the airborne poses, while long rectangular windows repeat across the background. Wide costume panels contrast with thin ropes and small belt details on the coloring sheet.

pages.description: Batman and Robin jump across a narrow rooftop gap in this printable coloring page, with Batman leading beneath a large crescent moon and Robin close behind. Their capes lift above the brick parapets as both figures stretch into midair poses. Rectangular windows, sparse masonry lines, and a simple skyline leave plenty of open areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman and Robin Studying a Gotham City Map at the Batcomputer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin studying a Gotham City map at the Batcomputer, with Batman pointing to a street near the map's center. Robin leans forward with folded arms beside him, surrounded by screens and control panels. Winding roads, a river, radar rings, and rows of buttons create detailed sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman Robin Pointing in City Courthouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin point outside the city courthouse in this printable coloring page, standing before its broad steps and columns with their arms extended in opposite directions. Long capes and simple pavement blocks contrast with the smaller chest emblems and belt details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman Robin Pointing in Police Headquarters Coloring Page

pages.title: Batman Robin Pointing in Shipping Yard Coloring Page

pages.title: Batman Robin Sitting in Arkham Asylum Coloring Page

pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Batman and Robin pointing in a city museum, standing beneath tall columns near a glass case displaying a crested helmet on a pedestal. pages.description: Batman and Robin stand together in a garden in this printable coloring page, framed by two large flowers, rounded shrubs, and a low picket fence behind them. pages.description: Batman and Robin watch from a rocky area in this printable coloring page, standing side by side on a raised stone ledge beneath a round moon. pages.title: Batman Robin Thinking In Challenge Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Batman and Robin consider a challenge area in this printable coloring page, standing among oversized puzzle pieces and gears above a short staircase of rectangular platforms. pages.description: Batman and Robin look around a meadow in this printable coloring page, standing between large tulip-shaped flowers with rolling hills and rounded clouds behind them in the distance. Simple rays and horizontal water marks keep the coloring sheet focused on the quiet view.

Curving lava borders, angular stones, and segmented utility belts create distinct areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.description: Batman and Robin walk slowly through a treasure room in this printable coloring page, passing open chests overflowing with coins, necklaces, crowns, and oversized faceted gems.
